rules.title: A foreigner can own a house in Indonesia only on Hak Pakai (right of use) land
rules.plain: A landed house owned by a foreigner must sit on Hak Pakai land: either plain Hak Pakai, Hak Pakai granted over someone's Hak Milik by a deed before a land deed official (PPAT), or Hak Pakai over Management Rights land under an agreement with the holder. Apartments (strata units) follow separate rules in the same article. If your contract promises you Hak Milik, or keeps the title in another person's name for you, ask a lawyer before paying.
rules.quote: Rumah tempat tinggal atau hunian yang dapat dimiliki oleh Orang Asing merupakan: a. rumah tapak di atas Tanah: 1. hak pakai; atau 2. hak pakai di atas: a) hak milik, yang dikuasai berdasarkan perjanjian pemberian hak pakai di atas hak milik dengan akta Pejabat Pembuat Akta Tanah; atau b) Hak Pengelolaan, berdasarkan perjanjian pemanfaatan Tanah dengan pemegang Hak Pengelolaan.
rules.translation: Houses or dwellings that may be owned by a Foreigner are: a. landed houses on Land: 1. right of use (hak pakai); or 2. right of use over: a) freehold (hak milik), held under an agreement granting right of use over freehold made by deed of a Land Deed Official; or b) Management Rights, under a land use agreement with the holder of the Management Rights.

rules.title: The foreign buyer needs an immigration document
rules.plain: Only a foreigner who holds an immigration document under Indonesian law can own a home. Check what the contract says about your status and which document the notary will ask for.
rules.quote: Orang Asing yang dapat memiliki rumah tempat tinggal atau hunian merupakan Orang Asing yang mempunyai dokumen keimigrasian sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
rules.translation: A Foreigner who may own a house or dwelling is a Foreigner who holds an immigration document in accordance with the laws and regulations.

rules.title: Hak Pakai on State or Management Rights land runs 30 years, then 20, then 30
rules.plain: Right of use with a time limit is granted for up to 30 years, can be extended for up to 20 years, and renewed for up to 30 years. An extension or renewal is an application, not automatic. Check which term your contract promises and who pays for extensions.
rules.quote: Hak pakai di atas Tanah Negara dan Tanah Hak Pengelolaan dengan jangka waktu diberikan untuk jangka waktu paling lama 30 (tiga puluh) tahun, diperpanjang untuk jangka waktu paling lama 20 (dua puluh) tahun, dan diperbarui untuk jangka waktu paling lama 30 (tiga puluh) tahun.
rules.translation: Right of use with a time limit over State Land and Management Rights Land is granted for at most 30 years, extended for at most 20 years, and renewed for at most 30 years.

rules.title: Foreign ownership has limits: minimum price, plot size, number of units, residential use
rules.plain: The regulation lets the government set a minimum price, a maximum plot size, a maximum number of plots or units, and requires residential use. The current figures are set in separate ministerial rules, so check them for your region before you sign.
rules.quote: Kepemilikan rumah tempat tinggal atau hunian Orang Asing sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 71 diberikan dengan batasan: a. minimal harga; b. luas bidang Tanah; c. jumlah bidang Tanah atau unit Satuan Rumah Susun; dan d. peruntukan untuk rumah tinggal atau hunian.
rules.translation: Ownership of a house or dwelling by a Foreigner as referred to in Article 71 is granted with limits on: a. minimum price; b. land plot area; c. number of land plots or strata units; and d. designation for residential use.

rules.title: Only Indonesian citizens can hold Hak Milik (freehold)
rules.plain: Freehold land (Hak Milik, often shown as SHM on the certificate) can only be held by an Indonesian citizen. A foreign buyer cannot be registered as the owner of Hak Milik land.
rules.quote: Hanya warga-negara Indonesia dapat mempunyai hak milik.
rules.translation: Only Indonesian citizens may hold freehold (hak milik).

rules.title: Arrangements that pass freehold to a foreigner, directly or indirectly, are void
rules.plain: Any sale or other act meant to transfer Hak Milik to a foreigner, directly or indirectly, is void by law, the land falls to the State, and money already paid to the owner cannot be claimed back. This is why nominee structures (an Indonesian holds the freehold for you) are a serious risk.
rules.quote: Setiap jual-beli, penukaran, penghibahan, pemberian dengan wasiat dan perbuatan-perbuatan lain yang dimaksudkan untuk langsung atau tidak langsung memindahkan hak milik kepada orang asing, kepada seorang warga-negara yang disamping kewarganegaraan Indonesianya mempunyai kewarga-negaraan asing atau kepada suatu badan hukum kecuali yang ditetapkan oleh Pemerintah termaksud dalam pasal 21 ayat (2), adalah batal karena hukum dan tanahnya jatuh kepada Negara, dengan ketentuan, bahwa hak-hak pihak lain yang membebaninya tetap berlangsung serta semua pembayaran yang telah diterima oleh pemilik tidak dapat dituntut kembali.
rules.translation: Every sale, exchange, gift, bequest and other act intended to transfer freehold directly or indirectly to a foreigner, to a citizen who also holds a foreign citizenship, or to a legal entity other than those set by the Government under Article 21(2), is void by law and the land falls to the State, provided that rights of other parties encumbering it continue and all payments already received by the owner cannot be claimed back.

rules.title: Leasehold: a lease of someone else's land for building
rules.plain: The basic land law recognises a lease of land owned by someone else for building, paid to the owner, and a foreigner domiciled in Indonesia may hold it. A lease is a contract with the land owner, so check the owner on the land certificate, the length of the lease, and the written terms for extension.
rules.quote: Seseorang atau suatu badan hukum mempunyai hak sewa atas tanah, apabila ia berhak mempergunakan tanah-milik orang lain untuk keperluan bangunan, dengan membayar kepada pemiliknya sejumlah uang sebagai sewa.
rules.translation: A person or legal entity has a lease right over land if entitled to use land owned by another for building, paying the owner a sum of money as rent.

rules.title: Pre-sales (PPJB) of houses under construction need land status, permits and 20% built first
rules.plain: Homes still being built may be sold through a preliminary sale agreement (PPJB) only after there is certainty on the land ownership, what is promised, the building permit, the infrastructure, and at least 20% of the housing built. Ask the developer for proof of each. This is the 2011 wording; the Job Creation law later amended parts of this law, so have a lawyer confirm the current text.
rules.quote: Perjanjian pendahuluan jual beli sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan setelah memenuhi persyaratan kepastian atas: a. status pemilikan tanah; b. hal yang diperjanjikan; c. kepemilikan izin mendirikan bangunan induk; d. ketersediaan prasarana, sarana, dan utilitas umum; dan e. keterbangunan perumahan paling sedikit 20% (dua puluh persen).
rules.translation: The preliminary sale agreement referred to in paragraph (1) is made after meeting the requirement of certainty on: a. the land ownership status; b. what is agreed; c. holding the main building permit; d. availability of infrastructure, facilities and public utilities; and e. at least 20% (twenty percent) of the housing built.

rules.title: PBG is the building approval; SLF certifies the building is fit for use
rules.plain: PBG (Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung) is the permit given to the building owner to build. SLF (Sertifikat Laik Fungsi) is issued by the local government to state the building is fit for function before it can be used. Both run through SIMBG, the government's web system, so a real PBG can be checked there.
rules.quote: perizinan yang diberikan kepada pemilik Bangunan Gedung untuk membangun baru ... sertifikat yang diberikan oleh Pemerintah Daerah untuk menyatakan kelaikan fungsi Bangunan Gedung sebelum dapat dimanfaatkan ... sistem elektronik berbasis web yang digunakan untuk melaksanakan proses penyelenggaraan PBG
rules.translation: a permit given to the owner of a Building to build new ... a certificate given by the Regional Government to state that a Building is fit for function before it can be used ... a web-based electronic system used to carry out the PBG process

rules.title: Off-plan sellers in Dubai must have an escrow account for the project
rules.plain: A developer that wants to sell units off-plan must apply to the Land Department to open an escrow account, and buyers' payments are deposited into an account opened in the name of the project. Pay only into the project's escrow account named in your contract, never to a personal or company operating account.
rules.quote: Any Developer who wishes to sell Units off-plan must submit to the Department a request to open an Escrow Account.

rules.title: Escrow money is only for building that project and is protected from the developer's creditors
rules.plain: Each project has its own escrow account, used only to build that project. The developer's creditors cannot seize the money in it.
rules.quote: An Escrow Account will be opened in the name of the project, and will be dedicated exclusively to the construction of that Real Estate Development project. No attachment may be imposed on the payments deposited in this account for the benefit of the creditors of the Developer.

rules.title: 5% of the escrow stays back for a year after units are registered
rules.plain: When the developer gets the completion certificate, the escrow agent keeps 5% of the account and releases it one year after the units are registered to buyers. A contract that lets the developer take everything at handover is worth asking about.
rules.quote: An Escrow Agent must retain five percent (5%) of the total value of each Escrow Account once the Developer obtains the completion certificate. The retained amount will be released to the Developer one (1) year from the registration of Units in the name of purchasers.

rules.title: If a project is not completed, the escrow agent must act to complete it or refund buyers
rules.plain: If the project is not completed, the escrow agent, after consulting the Land Department, must take measures to protect depositors: either get the project completed or refund their payments.
rules.quote: In the event of any emergency situation where the Real Estate Development project is not completed, the Escrow Agent of that project must, after consultation with the Department, take the required measures to preserve the rights of depositors, and ensure that the Real Estate Development project is completed, or depositors are refunded their payments.

rules.title: Off-plan advertising needs written permission from the Land Department
rules.plain: A developer may not advertise off-plan units, or promote them at exhibitions, without written authorisation from the Land Department. Dubai property ads now carry a permit QR code you can check (see our permit QR check).
rules.quote: A Developer may not advertise in local or international media, and may not participate in local or international exhibitions to promote the sale of Units or Real Property off-plan, unless he obtains an authorisation in writing from the Department.

rules.title: An off-plan sale must be entered in the Interim Property Register, or it is void
rules.plain: Every off-plan sale must be entered in the Land Department's Interim Property Register. A sale that is not registered there is void. Ask for proof of registration of your unit.
rules.quote: Any disposition that occurs in respect of any Real Property Unit sold off-plan will be entered in the Interim Property Register, and any sale or any other legal disposition that transfers or restricts ownership or any ancillary rights will be void unless entered in that Register.

rules.title: No off-plan sale before the developer holds the land and the approvals
rules.plain: A developer may not start a project or sell units off-plan before taking possession of the land and getting the required approvals.
rules.quote: No Master Developer or Sub-developer may commence a project or dispose of its Real Property Units by way of Off-plan Sale before taking possession of the land on which the project will be implemented and obtaining the required approvals from the Competent Entities in the Emirate.

rules.title: Foreigners together may own at most 49% of the unit area in a Thai condominium
rules.plain: In each condominium, all foreign owners together may hold at most 49% of the total area of all units. If the foreign quota is full, a foreigner cannot be registered as owner. Ask the developer for the current foreign quota figure and how your unit is counted.
rules.quote: อาคารชุดแต่ละอาคารชุดจะมีคนต่างด้าวหรือนิติบุคคลตามที่ระบุไว้ในมาตรา ๑๙ ถือกรรมสิทธิ์ในห้องชุดได้เมื่อรวมกันแล้วต้องไม่เกินอัตราร้อยละสี่สิบเก้าของเนื้อที่ของห้องชุดทั้งหมดในอาคารชุดนั้นในขณะที่ขอจดทะเบียนอาคารชุดตามมาตรา ๖
rules.translation: In each condominium, foreigners or juristic persons under section 19 may hold ownership of units which, combined, must not exceed forty-nine percent of the area of all units in that condominium at the time of applying to register the condominium under section 6.

rules.title: A foreign buyer must show the money came from abroad
rules.plain: A foreigner buying under the foreign funds route must show evidence that foreign currency was brought into Thailand, or was withdrawn from a non-resident baht account or a foreign currency account, for at least the price of the unit. Keep the bank's transfer documents for every payment.
rules.quote: สำหรับคนต่างด้าวและนิติบุคคลตามมาตรา ๑๙ (๕) ต้องแสดงหลักฐานการนำเงินตราต่างประเทศเข้ามาในราชอาณาจักรหรือหลักฐานการถอนเงินจากบัญชีเงินบาทของบุคคลที่มีถิ่นที่อยู่นอกประเทศหรือถอนเงินจากบัญชีเงินฝากเงินตราต่างประเทศในจำนวนไม่น้อยกว่าค่าห้องชุดที่จะซื้อ
rules.translation: Foreigners and juristic persons under section 19 (5) must show evidence of bringing foreign currency into the Kingdom, or evidence of withdrawing money from the baht account of a person resident abroad or from a foreign currency deposit account, in an amount not less than the price of the unit to be bought.

rules.title: In Spain, money paid before completion must be guaranteed and kept in a special account
rules.plain: A developer taking payments for homes under construction must guarantee their return plus legal interest, by insurance or a bank guarantee, from the moment it has the building licence, in case construction does not start or is not finished on time. The payments must go into a special bank account, separate from the developer's other money. Ask for your individual guarantee before you pay.
rules.quote: Garantizar, desde la obtención de la licencia de edificación, la devolución de las cantidades entregadas más los intereses legales, mediante contrato de seguro de caución suscrito con entidades aseguradoras debidamente autorizadas para operar en España, o mediante aval solidario emitido por entidades de crédito debidamente autorizadas, para el caso de que la construcción no se inicie o no llegue a buen fin en el plazo convenido para la entrega de la vivienda.
rules.translation: Guarantee, from the time the building licence is obtained, the return of the amounts paid plus legal interest, by a surety insurance contract with insurers duly authorised to operate in Spain, or by a joint and several guarantee issued by duly authorised credit institutions, in case construction does not start or is not completed within the period agreed for handing over the home.

rules.title: Penitential deposit (arras): buyer walks away and loses it, seller walks away and pays it back double
rules.plain: If the contract uses a deposit as arras or señal, either side can withdraw: the buyer by losing the deposit, the seller by returning it doubled. Check which kind of deposit your contract describes; contracts often say.
rules.quote: Si hubiesen mediado arras o señal en el contrato de compra y venta, podrá rescindirse el contrato allanándose el comprador a perderlas, o el vendedor a devolverlas duplicadas.
rules.translation: If a deposit (arras or señal) was given in the sale contract, the contract may be cancelled by the buyer agreeing to lose it, or by the seller returning it doubled.

rules.title: Promissory contract deposit (sinal): if the seller fails, the buyer can claim double
rules.plain: In a Portuguese promissory contract (contrato-promessa) with a deposit (sinal), if the buyer fails the seller keeps the deposit; if the seller fails, the buyer can demand double what was paid. The buyer can instead ask a court to enforce the sale.
rules.quote: Se quem constitui o sinal deixar de cumprir a obrigação por causa que lhe seja imputável, tem o outro contraente a faculdade de fazer sua a coisa entregue; se o não cumprimento do contrato for devido a este último, tem aquele a faculdade de exigir o dobro do que prestou
rules.translation: If the party who gave the deposit fails to perform for a reason attributable to them, the other party may keep what was given; if the failure is due to the latter, the former may demand double what they paid

rules.title: In Florida, deposits up to 10% of the price go into an escrow account until the condo is built
rules.plain: While construction of a condominium is not substantially completed, the developer must pay into an escrow account every payment you make up to 10% of the sale price, and the escrow agent gives you a receipt on request. If you properly terminate the contract, the money comes back to you with any interest earned. Ask for the name of the escrow agent and a receipt for each payment.
rules.quote: If a developer contracts to sell a condominium parcel and the construction, furnishing, and landscaping of the property submitted or proposed to be submitted to condominium ownership has not been substantially completed in accordance with the plans and specifications and representations made by the developer in the disclosures required by this chapter, the developer shall pay into an escrow account all payments up to 10 percent of the sale price received by the developer from the buyer towards the sale price. The escrow agent shall give to the purchaser a receipt for the deposit, upon request. [...] (a) If a buyer properly terminates the contract pursuant to its terms or pursuant to this chapter, the funds shall be paid to the buyer together with any interest earned.

rules.title: Payments above 10% go into a special escrow account, and can fund construction only if the contract says so
rules.plain: Money you pay above 10% of the price before construction is completed must sit in a special escrow account controlled by an escrow agent. The developer may use it for construction costs once construction has begun, but only if your contract provides for it, and the contract must then carry a bold warning on its first page. Read the first page of the contract for that warning before paying more than 10%.
rules.quote: All payments which are in excess of the 10 percent of the sale price described in subsection (1) and which have been received prior to completion of construction by the developer from the buyer on a contract for purchase of a condominium parcel shall be held in a special escrow account established as provided in subsection (1) and controlled by an escrow agent and may not be used by the developer prior to closing the transaction, except as provided in subsection (3) or except for refund to the buyer. [...] (3) If the contract for sale of the condominium unit so provides, the developer may withdraw escrow funds in excess of 10 percent of the purchase price from the special account required by subsection (2) when the construction of improvements has begun.

rules.title: The escrow agent must be independent of the developer
rules.plain: The escrow must be held by a bank, a savings and loan association, a Florida Bar attorney, a registered real estate broker, an authorised title insurer or a lending institution worth more than $5 million, and never by the developer or anyone working for or linked to it. Check who the escrow agent named in your contract is.
rules.quote: Every escrow agent shall be independent of the developer, and no developer or any officer, director, affiliate, subsidiary, or employee of a developer may serve as escrow agent.

rules.title: If the developer breaks the escrow rules, you can void the contract and get your money back with interest
rules.plain: A developer that does not follow the escrow rules makes the contract voidable by the buyer, and everything you deposited or advanced must be refunded with interest. Willful failure to use escrow is also a felony of the third degree under the same section.
rules.quote: The failure to comply with the provisions of this section renders the contract voidable by the buyer, and, if voided, all sums deposited or advanced under the contract shall be refunded with interest at the highest rate then being paid on savings accounts, excluding certificates of deposit, by savings and loan associations in the area in which the condominium property is located.

rules.title: You can cancel a developer contract within 15 days
rules.plain: A developer contract for a residential condominium unit must say that the buyer can cancel it in writing within 15 days after signing and receiving all the documents the developer must deliver, and again within 15 days of any amendment that changes the offering against the buyer. A waiver of this right has no effect.
rules.quote: THIS AGREEMENT IS VOIDABLE BY BUYER BY DELIVERING WRITTEN NOTICE OF THE BUYER’S INTENTION TO CANCEL WITHIN 15 DAYS AFTER THE DATE OF EXECUTION OF THIS AGREEMENT BY THE BUYER, AND RECEIPT BY BUYER OF ALL OF THE ITEMS REQUIRED TO BE DELIVERED TO HIM OR HER BY THE DEVELOPER UNDER SECTION 718.503, FLORIDA STATUTES. THIS AGREEMENT IS ALSO VOIDABLE BY BUYER BY DELIVERING WRITTEN NOTICE OF THE BUYER’S INTENTION TO CANCEL WITHIN 15 DAYS AFTER THE DATE OF RECEIPT FROM THE DEVELOPER OF ANY AMENDMENT WHICH MATERIALLY ALTERS OR MODIFIES THE OFFERING IN A MANNER THAT IS ADVERSE TO THE BUYER. ANY PURPORTED WAIVER OF THESE VOIDABILITY RIGHTS SHALL BE OF NO EFFECT.

rules.title: In Victoria, an off-the-plan deposit is capped at 10% and held on trust until the plan is registered
rules.plain: A seller in Victoria may not sign an off-the-plan contract unless the deposit is paid to a legal practitioner, conveyancer or licensed estate agent acting for the seller, who holds it on trust for you until the plan of subdivision is registered, and the deposit may not be more than 10% of the price. Never pay a deposit straight to the developer.
rules.quote: A vendor must not enter into an off-the-plan contract with any person, except a statutory body or authority, unless [...] (a) the off-the-plan contract provides that the deposit moneys payable by the purchaser are to be paid [...] (i) to a legal practitioner, conveyancer or licensed estate agent acting for the vendor to be held by the legal practitioner, conveyancer or licensed estate agent on trust for the purchaser until the registration of the plan of subdivision; and [...] (b) the deposit moneys payable under the contract do not exceed 10 per cent of the purchase price of the lot.

rules.title: If the plan is not registered within 18 months (or the agreed period), you can rescind
rules.plain: If the plan of subdivision is not registered within 18 months of the contract date, or within another period the contract sets, you may rescind the contract at any time after that period and before the plan is registered. You may also rescind before registration if the seller broke the deposit or disclosure rules.
rules.quote: (1) If the vendor under an off-the-plan contract fails to comply with section 9AA(1) or (2), 9AB or 9ADA the purchaser may rescind the off-the-plan contract at any time before the registration of the plan of subdivision. (2) If the plan of subdivision is not registered within 18 months after the date of an off-the-plan contract for the sale of a lot on that plan of subdivision, or, if the contract specifies another period, before the end of that specified period, the purchaser may, at any time after the expiration of that period but before the plan is so registered, rescind the contract.

rules.title: A seller can use a sunset clause only with your written consent or a court order
rules.plain: For a residential off-the-plan contract, the seller may rescind under a sunset clause only if the plan is not registered or the occupancy permit is not issued by the sunset date, and only after giving you at least 28 days written notice and getting your written consent. You do not have to consent. Without your consent, the seller must ask the Supreme Court, which decides whether rescission is just and equitable.
rules.quote: (1) A vendor must not rescind a residential off-the-plan contract under a sunset clause in that contract except as provided for in this Division. (2) Subject to subsection (3), a vendor may rescind a residential off-the-plan contract under a sunset clause if [...] (a) the relevant plan of subdivision has not been registered by the sunset date; or (b) an occupancy permit has not been issued by the sunset date. (3) Before rescinding a residential off-the-plan contract under a sunset clause, the vendor must obtain the written consent of each purchaser to the rescission after giving each purchaser, at least 28 days before the proposed rescission, written notice setting out [...] (c) that the purchaser is not obliged to consent to the proposed rescission. [...] 10E (1) A vendor under a residential off-the-plan contract that contains a sunset clause may apply to the Supreme Court for an order permitting the vendor to rescind the contract under the sunset clause.

rules.title: In Mexico, a developer selling homes must register its sales contracts with Profeco
rules.plain: The consumer law applies when the seller is a developer, builder, promoter or anyone else advising on and selling homes to the public, and those contracts must be registered with the Federal Consumer Protection Agency (Profeco). Ask for the Profeco registration of the contract you are given.
rules.quote: Los actos relacionados con inmuebles sólo estarán sujetos a esta ley, cuando los proveedores sean fraccionadores, constructores, promotores y demás personas que intervengan en la asesoría y venta al público de viviendas destinadas a casa habitación [...] Los contratos relacionados con las actividades a que se refiere el párrafo anterior, deberán registrarse ante la Procuraduría.
rules.translation: Acts relating to real property are subject to this law only when the suppliers are land subdividers, builders, developers and other persons who take part in advising on and selling to the public homes intended as dwellings [...] Contracts relating to the activities referred to in the previous paragraph must be registered with the Agency (Procuraduría).

rules.title: In a presale, the developer must show the full construction project and the permits
rules.plain: Before you buy in a presale (preventa), the developer must make available the complete executive construction project and the model, and, for new homes or presales, the authorisations, licences and permits issued for the construction. Ask to see them, and check them with the issuing authority.
rules.cite: Article 73 BIS, sections I and V
rules.quote: I. En caso de preventa, el proveedor deberá exhibir el proyecto ejecutivo de construcción completo, así como la maqueta respectiva y, en su caso, el inmueble muestra; [...] V. Para el caso de inmuebles nuevos o preventas, las autorizaciones, licencias o permisos expedidos por las autoridades correspondientes para la construcción, relativas a las especificaciones técnicas, seguridad, uso de suelo, la clase de materiales utilizados en la construcción; servicios básicos con que cuenta, así como todos aquellos con los que debe contar de conformidad con la legislación aplicable.
rules.translation: I. In the case of a presale, the supplier must exhibit the complete executive construction project, as well as the corresponding model and, where applicable, the show unit; [...] V. For new properties or presales, the authorisations, licences or permits issued by the competent authorities for the construction, relating to the technical specifications, safety, land use, the type of materials used in the construction; the basic services it has, as well as all those it must have under the applicable legislation.

rules.title: The developer must tell you how you can cancel and what guarantee backs the deal
rules.plain: The developer must inform you of the conditions under which you can cancel the purchase, and of any mortgage, trust (fideicomiso) or other guarantee that exists and how it is set up. Mexican law does not require an escrow account for presales, so ask in writing where your payments go and what protects them.
rules.cite: Article 73 BIS, sections XII and XIII
rules.quote: XII. Las condiciones bajo las cuales el consumidor puede cancelar la operación, y XIII. Se deberá indicar al consumidor sobre la existencia y constitución de garantía hipotecaria, fiduciaria o de cualquier otro tipo, así como su instrumentación.
rules.translation: XII. The conditions under which the consumer may cancel the transaction, and XIII. The consumer must be informed of the existence and creation of any mortgage, trust or other guarantee, and how it is put in place.

rules.title: The contract must set a delivery date and penalties that are equal for both sides
rules.plain: A registered home sale contract must state the start and end dates of the work and the delivery date of the property, and any contractual penalties for breach must be reciprocal and equivalent for seller and buyer. The developer is excused from the agreed delivery date only if it fully proves force majeure or an unforeseeable event.
rules.cite: Article 73 TER, sections IX and XII
rules.quote: IX. Las penas convencionales que se apliquen tanto al proveedor como al consumidor por el incumplimiento de las obligaciones contraídas, las cuales deberán ser recíprocas y equivalentes, sin perjuicio de lo dispuesto por los ordenamientos legales aplicables; [...] XII. Fecha de inicio y término de ejecución de la actividad o servicio contratado, así como la de entrega del bien objeto del contrato; esto último, de conformidad con lo dispuesto por el artículo 74 de esta Ley. El proveedor únicamente quedará exento de la obligación de entregar en la fecha convenida, cuando acredite plenamente, que la entrega no se realizó en la misma por caso fortuito o fuerza mayor que afecte directamente, a él o al bien, pudiéndose pactar sin responsabilidad alguna, una nueva fecha de entrega;
rules.translation: IX. The contractual penalties applicable to both the supplier and the consumer for breach of the obligations undertaken, which must be reciprocal and equivalent, without prejudice to the applicable laws; [...] XII. The start and end date of the contracted activity or service, and the date of delivery of the property covered by the contract, the latter in accordance with article 74 of this Law. The supplier is exempt from the obligation to deliver on the agreed date only when it fully proves that delivery did not take place on that date because of an unforeseeable event or force majeure directly affecting it or the property, in which case a new delivery date may be agreed without liability.

rules.title: A new home comes with at least a 5-year structural warranty
rules.plain: Every home sold under the consumer law must come with a warranty of at least five years for structural matters, three years for waterproofing and one year for everything else, counted from actual delivery. During the warranty the developer must repair defects at no cost to you.
rules.quote: Todo bien inmueble cuya transacción esté regulada por esta Ley, deberá ofrecerse al consumidor con la garantía correspondiente, la cual no podrá ser inferior a cinco años para cuestiones estructurales y tres años para impermeabilización; para los demás elementos la garantía mínima será de un año. Todos los plazos serán contados a partir de la entrega real del bien.
rules.translation: Every property whose transaction is governed by this Law must be offered to the consumer with the corresponding warranty, which may not be less than five years for structural matters and three years for waterproofing; for the other elements the minimum warranty is one year. All periods are counted from the actual delivery of the property.

rules.title: In Japan, a developer selling before completion needs a bank guarantee or insurance for your advance payments
rules.plain: When a licensed real estate business sells a home it is still building, it may not take your deposit or other advance payments until a bank or other designated institution guarantees their refund, or a guarantee insurance policy covers them, and you are given the guarantee document or policy. Small amounts are exempt (see the next note). If the developer has not taken these measures, you may refuse to pay.
rules.quote: 宅地建物取引業者は、宅地の造成又は建築に関する工事の完了前において行う当該工事に係る宅地又は建物の売買で自ら売主となるものに関しては、次の各号のいずれかに掲げる措置を講じた後でなければ、買主から手付金等（代金の全部又は一部として授受される金銭及び手付金その他の名義をもつて授受される金銭で代金に充当されるものであつて、契約の締結の日以後当該宅地又は建物の引渡し前に支払われるものをいう。以下同じ。）を受領してはならない。[...] ４ 宅地建物取引業者が、第一項に規定する宅地又は建物の売買を行う場合（同項ただし書に該当する場合を除く。）において、同項第一号又は第二号に掲げる措置を講じないときは、買主は、手付金等を支払わないことができる。
rules.translation: In a sale, with itself as the seller, of land or a building covered by works for land development or construction made before those works are completed, a real estate business may not receive advance payments (money paid as all or part of the price, and money paid as a deposit or under any other name that counts towards the price, paid on or after the contract date and before handover) from the buyer until it has taken one of the following measures. [...] 4. If a real estate business makes such a sale (other than in the cases of the proviso) without taking the measure in item 1 or item 2, the buyer may refuse to pay the advance payments.

rules.title: The guarantee is required once advance payments pass 5% of the price or 10 million yen
rules.plain: The guarantee rule does not apply while the total advance payments are no more than 5% of the price and no more than an amount set by Cabinet Order, which the Order sets at 10 million yen, or once the title is registered in your name. Above either limit, ask for the guarantee document before paying.
rules.cite: Article 3-5, with Article 41(1) proviso of the Act
rules.quote: 法第四十一条第一項ただし書及び第四十一条の二第一項ただし書の政令で定める額は、千万円とする。
rules.translation: The amount set by Cabinet Order under the proviso to Article 41(1) and the proviso to Article 41-2(1) of the Act is ten million yen.

rules.title: The deposit may not exceed 20% of the price, and you can walk away by giving it up
rules.plain: A real estate business selling as the seller may not take a deposit (tetsukekin) of more than 20% of the price. Whatever the contract calls the deposit, you may cancel by giving it up, and the seller may cancel by paying you double, until the other side has started performing the contract. Terms worse for you than this are void.
rules.quote: 宅地建物取引業者は、自ら売主となる宅地又は建物の売買契約の締結に際して、代金の額の十分の二を超える額の手付を受領することができない。 ２ 宅地建物取引業者が、自ら売主となる宅地又は建物の売買契約の締結に際して手付を受領したときは、その手付がいかなる性質のものであつても、買主はその手付を放棄して、当該宅地建物取引業者はその倍額を現実に提供して、契約の解除をすることができる。 ただし、その相手方が契約の履行に着手した後は、この限りでない。 ３ 前項の規定に反する特約で、買主に不利なものは、無効とする。
rules.translation: A real estate business may not, on concluding a sale contract for land or a building of which it is itself the seller, receive a deposit exceeding two tenths of the price. 2. When a real estate business receives a deposit on concluding such a contract, whatever the nature of the deposit, the buyer may cancel the contract by giving up the deposit, and the real estate business by actually tendering double its amount; this does not apply after the other party has started performing the contract. 3. A special agreement contrary to the preceding paragraph that is unfavourable to the buyer is void.

rules.title: Signed away from the seller's office? You can cancel in writing within 8 days
rules.plain: If you made the offer or signed the contract somewhere other than the seller's office (for example at a hotel event or at home), you may withdraw or cancel in writing, without paying damages or a penalty, and the seller must promptly return your deposit and other money. The right ends 8 days after you are told about it in writing, or once the home is handed over and fully paid.
rules.quote: 宅地建物取引業者が自ら売主となる宅地又は建物の売買契約について、当該宅地建物取引業者の事務所その他国土交通省令・内閣府令で定める場所（以下この条において「事務所等」という。）以外の場所において、当該宅地又は建物の買受けの申込みをした者又は売買契約を締結した買主（事務所等において買受けの申込みをし、事務所等以外の場所において売買契約を締結した買主を除く。）は、次に掲げる場合を除き、書面により、当該買受けの申込みの撤回又は当該売買契約の解除（以下この条において「申込みの撤回等」という。）を行うことができる。 この場合において、宅地建物取引業者は、申込みの撤回等に伴う損害賠償又は違約金の支払を請求することができない。 一 [...] その告げられた日から起算して八日を経過したとき。 二 申込者等が、当該宅地又は建物の引渡しを受け、かつ、その代金の全部を支払つたとき。 [...] ３ 申込みの撤回等が行われた場合においては、宅地建物取引業者は、申込者等に対し、速やかに、買受けの申込み又は売買契約の締結に際し受領した手付金その他の金銭を返還しなければならない。
rules.translation: For a sale contract for land or a building of which a real estate business is itself the seller, a person who offered to buy, or a buyer who signed the contract, at a place other than the business's office or another place set by ministerial order (the "office"), other than a buyer who made the offer at the office and signed elsewhere, may withdraw the offer or cancel the contract in writing, except in the following cases. In that case the real estate business may not claim damages or a penalty for the withdrawal or cancellation. 1. [...] when eight days have passed from the day the person was told [in writing of this right and how to use it]. 2. When the person has received the land or building and paid the full price. [...] 3. After a withdrawal or cancellation, the real estate business must promptly return the deposit and any other money received for the offer or the contract.

rules.title: In the UK, a deposit paid to an estate agent is held on trust for you
rules.plain: Money an estate agent receives from you in England, Wales or Northern Ireland, including a deposit held as stakeholder until completion, is clients' money that the agent holds on trust, not the agent's own money. UK law has no general escrow rule for new-build deposits paid to a developer's solicitor, so ask in writing who holds your deposit and on what terms.
rules.quote: It is hereby declared that clients’ money received by any person in the course of estate agency work in England, Wales or Northern Ireland [...] (a) is held by him on trust for the person who is entitled to call for it to be paid over to him or to be paid on his direction or to have it otherwise credited to him, or (b) if it is received by him as stakeholder, is held by him on trust for the person who may become so entitled on the occurrence of the event against which the money is held.

rules.title: Builders owe every buyer a legal duty that a new home is fit to live in
rules.plain: In England and Wales, everyone who takes on work to provide a new dwelling owes a duty to the person who ordered it and to every later owner that the work is done in a workmanlike or professional way, with proper materials, so that the home is fit for habitation when completed. For time limits, a claim counts from the date the dwelling was completed.
rules.quote: A person taking on work for or in connection with the provision of a dwelling (whether the dwelling is provided by the erection or by the conversion or enlargement of a building) owes a duty [...] (a) if the dwelling is provided to the order of any person, to that person; and (b) without prejudice to paragraph (a) above, to every person who acquires an interest (whether legal or equitable) in the dwelling; to see that the work which he takes on is done in a workmanlike or, as the case may be, professional manner, with proper materials and so that as regards that work the dwelling will be fit for habitation when completed. [...] (5) Any cause of action in respect of a breach of the duty imposed by this section shall be deemed, for the purposes of the Limitation Act 1980, to have accrued at the time when the dwelling was completed [...]

rules.title: You have 15 years from completion to sue over a home unfit to live in
rules.plain: A claim under that duty must be brought within 15 years of when the right of action arose, which is the date the dwelling was completed. For claims that arose before section 135 of the Building Safety Act 2022 came into force (28 June 2022, as recorded on legislation.gov.uk), the limit is 30 years. Keep your completion date and documents.
rules.quote: (1) Where by virtue of a relevant provision a person becomes entitled to bring an action against any other person, no action may be brought after the expiration of 15 years from the date on which the right of action accrued. [...] (3) In this section “relevant provision” means (a) section 1 or 2A of the Defective Premises Act 1972; (b) section 38 of the Building Act 1984. (4) Where by virtue of section 1 of the Defective Premises Act 1972 a person became entitled, before the commencement date, to bring an action against any other person, this section applies in relation to the action as if the reference in subsection (1) to 15 years were a reference to 30 years. (5) In subsection (4) “the commencement date” means the day on which section 135 of the Building Safety Act 2022 came into force.

rules.title: In Turkey, no off-plan sale to a consumer before the building permit, and an information form one day before
rules.plain: A seller may not sign a pre-paid home sale contract (selling a home you pay for before it is handed over) with a consumer before it holds the building permit (yapı ruhsatı), and must give you a pre-contract information form at least one day before signing. Ask for the permit number and check it with the municipality.
rules.quote: (1) Ön ödemeli konut satış sözleşmesi, tüketicinin konut amaçlı bir taşınmazın satış bedelini önceden peşin veya taksitle ödemeyi, satıcının da bedelin tamamen veya kısmen ödenmesinden sonra taşınmazı tüketiciye devir veya teslim etmeyi üstlendiği sözleşmedir. (2) Tüketicilere sözleşmenin kurulmasından en az bir gün önce, Bakanlıkça belirlenen hususları içeren ön bilgilendirme formu verilmek zorundadır. (3) Yapı ruhsatı alınmadan, tüketicilerle ön ödemeli konut satış sözleşmesi yapılamaz.
rules.translation: (1) A pre-paid home sale contract is a contract in which the consumer undertakes to pay the sale price of a property for housing in advance, in cash or in instalments, and the seller undertakes to transfer or deliver the property to the consumer after the price is paid in full or in part. (2) Consumers must be given, at least one day before the contract is concluded, a pre-information form containing the matters set by the Ministry. (3) No pre-paid home sale contract may be made with consumers before the building permit is obtained.

rules.title: The sale must be registered at the land registry or made before a notary, and no payment before a valid contract
rules.plain: A pre-paid home sale must be registered in the land registry (tapu), or the promise-to-sell contract must be drawn up by a notary. If not, the seller cannot later use the defect against you. Until a valid contract exists, the seller may not ask you for any payment under any name, or for any document that puts you in debt.
rules.quote: (1) Ön ödemeli konut satışının tapu siciline tescil edilmesi, satış vaadi sözleşmesinin ise noterde düzenleme şeklinde yapılması zorunludur. Aksi hâlde satıcı, sonradan sözleşmenin geçersizliğini tüketicinin aleyhine olacak şekilde ileri süremez. (2) Satıcı, geçerli bir sözleşme yapılmış olmadıkça tüketiciden herhangi bir isim altında ödeme yapmasını veya tüketiciyi borç altına sokan herhangi bir belge vermesini isteyemez.
rules.translation: (1) A pre-paid home sale must be registered in the land registry, and a promise-to-sell contract must be drawn up before a notary. Otherwise the seller may not later claim the invalidity of the contract against the consumer. (2) Unless a valid contract has been made, the seller may not ask the consumer to make a payment under any name or to give any document that puts the consumer in debt.

rules.title: Larger projects need building completion insurance, which creditors cannot seize
rules.plain: For projects above a size set by the Ministry (number of homes or total value), the seller must take out building completion insurance, or provide another guarantee the Ministry sets, before starting pre-paid sales. Payouts and guarantees under that insurance cannot go into a bankruptcy estate or be seized. Ask whether the project is above the threshold and for the insurance policy.
rules.quote: (1) Bakanlıkça projedeki konut adedi ya da projenin toplam bedeli kriterine göre belirlenecek büyüklüğün üzerindeki projeler için satıcının ön ödemeli konut satışına başlamadan önce; kapsamı, koşulları ve uygulama esasları Hazine Müsteşarlığınca belirlenen bina tamamlama sigortası yaptırması veya Bakanlıkça belirlenen diğer teminat ve şartları sağlaması zorunludur. (2) Bina tamamlama sigortası kapsamında sağlanan tazminat, teminat ve benzeri güvenceler iflas veya tasfiye masasına dâhil edilemez, haczolunamaz, üzerlerine ihtiyati tedbir ve ihtiyati haciz konulamaz.
rules.translation: (1) For projects above a size to be set by the Ministry by the number of homes in the project or its total value, the seller must, before starting pre-paid home sales, take out building completion insurance whose scope, conditions and rules are set by the Undersecretariat of the Treasury, or meet the other guarantees and conditions set by the Ministry. (2) Compensation, guarantees and similar securities provided under building completion insurance may not be included in a bankruptcy or liquidation estate, may not be seized, and may not be subject to interim injunctions or attachments.

rules.title: You can withdraw within 14 days without giving a reason or paying a penalty
rules.plain: You have 14 days to withdraw from a pre-paid home sale contract without any reason and without paying a penalty. It is enough to send the notice to the seller within that period, and the seller must prove it told you about this right.
rules.quote: Tüketici, on dört gün içinde herhangi bir gerekçe göstermeksizin ve cezai şart ödemeksizin ön ödemeli konut satış sözleşmesinden cayma hakkına sahiptir. Cayma hakkının kullanıldığına dair bildirimin bu süre içinde satıcıya yöneltilmiş olması yeterlidir. Satıcı, cayma hakkı konusunda tüketicinin bilgilendirildiğini ispat etmekle yükümlüdür.
rules.translation: The consumer has the right to withdraw from the pre-paid home sale contract within fourteen days without giving any reason and without paying a penalty. It is enough that notice of the withdrawal is sent to the seller within this period. The seller must prove that the consumer was informed about the right of withdrawal.

rules.title: The home must be delivered on the promised date, and never later than 48 months after the contract
rules.plain: The seller must deliver the home within the period promised in the contract, and that period can never be longer than 48 months from the contract date. Registering the floor easement (kat irtifakı) in your name together with handing over possession counts as delivery.
rules.quote: Ön ödemeli konutun sözleşmede taahhüt edilen süre içinde tüketiciye teslim edilmesi zorunludur. Bu süre her hâlükârda sözleşme tarihinden itibaren kırk sekiz ayı geçemez. Kat irtifakının tüketici adına tapu siciline tescil edilmesiyle birlikte zilyetliğin devri hâlinde de devir ve teslim yapılmış sayılır.
rules.translation: The pre-paid home must be delivered to the consumer within the period promised in the contract. This period may in no case exceed forty-eight months from the contract date. Transfer and delivery are also deemed made when possession is transferred together with registration of the floor easement in the land registry in the consumer’s name.

rules.title: For 24 months you can cancel without a reason, paying at most 2% to 8% of the price
rules.plain: Within 24 months of the contract date you may cancel a pre-paid home sale without giving a reason. The seller may then claim the taxes and fees caused by the sale plus compensation of up to 2% of the price in the first three months, 4% from three to six months, 6% from six to twelve months and 8% from twelve to 24 months. If the seller did not perform its obligations, it can claim nothing. Your money must be returned within 180 days of the notice reaching the seller.
rules.quote: (1) Ön ödemeli konut satışında sözleşme tarihinden itibaren yirmidört aya kadar tüketicinin herhangi bir gerekçe göstermeden sözleşmeden dönme hakkı vardır. Sözleşmeden dönülmesi durumunda satıcı; konutun satışı veya satış vaadi sözleşmesi nedeniyle oluşan vergi, harç ve benzeri yasal yükümlülüklerden doğan masraflar ile sözleşme tarihinden itibaren ilk üç ay için sözleşme bedelinin yüzde ikisine, üç ila altı ay arası için yüzde dördüne, altı ila oniki ay arası için yüzde altısına ve oniki ila yirmidört ay arası için de yüzde sekizine kadar tazminatın ödenmesini isteyebilir. (2) Satıcı, yükümlülüklerini hiç ya da gereği gibi yerine getirmezse tüketiciden herhangi bir bedel talep edemez. [...] (3) Sözleşmeden dönülmesi durumunda, tüketiciye iade edilmesi gereken tutar ve tüketiciyi borç altına sokan her türlü belge, dönme bildiriminin satıcıya ulaştığı tarihten itibaren en geç yüzseksen gün içinde tüketiciye geri verilir.
rules.translation: (1) In a pre-paid home sale, the consumer has the right to rescind the contract without giving any reason up to twenty-four months from the contract date. If the contract is rescinded, the seller may ask for the costs arising from taxes, fees and similar legal obligations caused by the sale or promise-to-sell contract, and for compensation of up to two percent of the contract price for the first three months from the contract date, up to four percent between three and six months, up to six percent between six and twelve months, and up to eight percent between twelve and twenty-four months. (2) If the seller does not perform its obligations at all or properly, it may not claim any amount from the consumer. [...] (3) If the contract is rescinded, the amount to be refunded to the consumer and every document putting the consumer in debt are returned to the consumer within one hundred and eighty days at the latest from the date the rescission notice reaches the seller.

rules.title: In Costa Rica, a developer needs MEIC authorisation before it offers homes that are not yet built
rules.plain: Before a pre-sale of a real estate project is offered to the public, the developer must hold an authorisation of its sales plan from the consumer protection directorate (DAC) of the Ministry of Economy, Industry and Commerce (MEIC). Without it, the DAC asks the national consumer commission to stop the marketing, and everyone who organises, promotes or sells the plan is liable. Ask for the authorisation before you pay.
rules.quote: Artículo 4º-Sobre el ofrecimiento de venta a plazo de ejecución futura de proyectos inmobiliarios. Previo al ofrecimiento público y generalizado, el comerciante o responsable del proyecto debe contar con la respectiva autorización del Plan de venta a plazo de ejecución futura del proyecto inmobiliario por parte de la DAC. Caso contrario, la DAC interpondrá una denuncia con solicitud de medida cautelar ante la CNC, para impedir la comercialización y publicidad que en este sentido se haya dispuesto, así como informarlo a las personas consumidoras. El ofrecimiento de venta a plazo de ejecución futura de proyectos inmobiliarios bajo esta modalidad, que no cuenten con la autorización dispuesta en el párrafo anterior, implicará responsabilidad para todos los agentes económicos involucrados en la organización, promoción, comercialización y desarrollo del plan de venta a plazo o de ejecución futura de bienes inmuebles.
rules.translation: Before any public and general offer, the trader or person responsible for the project must hold the authorisation of the plan for the future-execution instalment sale of the real estate project from the DAC. Otherwise, the DAC will file a complaint with a request for an interim measure before the CNC to stop the marketing and advertising arranged for it, and will inform consumers. Offering such sales without the authorisation set out above makes all economic agents involved in organising, promoting, marketing and developing the plan liable.

rules.title: MEIC publishes the authorised plans and contract models, and certifies them on request
rules.plain: MEIC keeps a public database on its website of the authorised real estate plans and the authorised contract models. Anyone can ask for a certificate, which the DAC has eight working days to issue. Check that the project and the contract you are offered are on that list.
rules.quote: Artículo 9º-Publicidad de la información. El MEIC a través de la DAC mantendrá una base de datos con información actualizada y permanente a disposición del público por medio de su propia página web, sobre los planes de desarrollo inmobiliario autorizados y modelos de contratos autorizados, de conformidad con el artículo 5 del presente reglamento.
rules.translation: Through the DAC, MEIC will keep an up-to-date and permanent database available to the public on its own website on the authorised real estate development plans and authorised contract models, in accordance with article 5 of this regulation.

rules.title: Your down payment must be held in a trust before the plan is authorised
rules.plain: To authorise the plan, MEIC checks that the developer has a trust (fideicomiso) that protects buyers' down payments (primas), so that the money is used to build the project; failing that, the developer must post a guarantee or bond. The trust holds your down payment, extra payments and additional instalments, and the developer keeps all its duties under your contract.
rules.quote: Artículo 13.-Comprobación de la solvencia económica con respecto al Plan de venta a plazo de ejecución futura de proyectos inmobiliarios. Para los efectos de la autorización del plan de venta a plazo de ejecución futura de proyectos inmobiliarios, el MEIC comprobará que el comerciante o responsable cuenta con un fideicomiso de protección de primas, que se define en la Sección II del presente Capítulo para garantizar que los recursos que aporten por este concepto los consumidores sean administrados adecuadamente para materializar el plan. [...] Artículo 15.-Objeto del Fideicomiso. El Fideicomiso a que se refiere estas disposiciones tiene como objeto principal la custodia, manejo y administración de las primas, pagos extraordinarios o abonos adicionales por parte del consumidor o promitente comprador que deben ser entregados al comerciante o responsable del plan.
rules.translation: For the authorisation of the plan, MEIC will check that the trader or person responsible has a trust for the protection of down payments, defined in Section II of this Chapter, to guarantee that the resources consumers contribute for this purpose are properly managed to carry out the plan. [...] The main purpose of the Trust is the custody, handling and administration of the down payments, extraordinary payments or additional instalments by the consumer or promissory buyer that must be delivered to the trader or person responsible for the plan.

rules.title: The trust pays the developer in six steps, at 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% and 100% of construction
rules.plain: The trustee releases your money to the developer gradually, against a construction progress report by an impartial civil engineer registered with the CFIA and named by the trustee. There are six releases, when the works reach 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% and 100%, each the same share of what buyers have paid. Ask the trustee for the latest progress report.
rules.quote: Artículo 25.-Sobre los desembolsos del fideicomiso en favor del comerciante o responsable del plan y su terminación normal. Los recursos de las primas, pagos extraordinarios o abonos adicionales serán desembolsados gradualmente al comerciante o responsable del plan por el fiduciario de acuerdo con el informe de avance de construcción realizado por un perito fiscalizador imparcial, profesional en ingeniería civil, inscrito en el CFIA independiente y nombrado por el fiduciario. En caso de que el proyecto cuente con un financiamiento de una entidad supervisada por SUGEF, el fiduciario podrá utilizar el mismo informe pericial de avance de construcción rendido al ente financiero. [...] a. Se harán 6 desembolsos, una vez que se logre el 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% y el 100% del avance de la obra del Plan de venta a plazo o de ejecución futura de bienes inmuebles, por etapa o finca filial.
rules.translation: The resources from down payments, extraordinary payments or additional instalments will be released gradually to the trader or person responsible for the plan by the trustee, according to the construction progress report made by an impartial supervising expert, a civil engineering professional registered with the CFIA, independent and appointed by the trustee. [...] a. There will be 6 releases, once 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% and 100% of the progress of the works of the plan is reached, by stage or unit.

rules.title: If the developer breaks the contract, you are owed 100% of what you paid
rules.plain: If the developer does not perform the contract, you have the right to get back 100% of your down payment, extra payments and additional instalments. The developer must pay you whatever the trust does not hold in your individual sub-account.
rules.quote: Artículo 26.-Sobre la responsabilidad de devolución del 100% de los aportes. En caso de incumplimiento de contrato por parte del comerciante o responsable del plan, el consumidor o promitente comprador tiene derecho a la devolución del 100% de los aportes o sumas pagadas por concepto de primas, pagos extraordinarios o abonos adicionales. Para tales efectos el comerciante o responsable del plan deberá devolver la diferencia entre el dinero registrado en la subcuenta individual a nombre del consumidor que tenga el fiduciario en su poder y el total del aporte entregado por el consumidor o promitente comprador; lo anterior de conformidad con lo establecido en los artículos 32 inciso b), 34 incisos a) y b); 53 y 57 de la Ley N° 7472.
rules.translation: If the trader or person responsible for the plan breaches the contract, the consumer or promissory buyer has the right to the return of 100% of the contributions or sums paid as down payments, extraordinary payments or additional instalments. For this purpose the trader or person responsible for the plan must return the difference between the money recorded in the consumer's individual sub-account held by the trustee and the total contribution delivered by the consumer or promissory buyer, in accordance with articles 32(b), 34(a) and (b), 53 and 57 of Law No. 7472.

rules.title: In Cyprus, the seller must attach a recent land search certificate to the sale contract
rules.plain: For contracts signed since the 2023 amendment took effect, the seller must attach to the contract a search certificate of the property, dated no more than five working days from the day the contract is signed. The certificate shows the mortgages and other charges on the property. A seller who does not attach it can be fined up to EUR 10,000 by the Director of the Department of Lands and Surveys. Read the certificate before you pay.
rules.quote: (1Α) Ανεξάρτητα από τις διατάξεις του περί Συμβάσεων Νόμου, ο πωλητής περιλαμβάνει ως αναπόσπαστο μέρος της σύμβασης, η οποία συνομολογείται μετά από την ημερομηνία έναρξης της ισχύος του περί Πώλησης Ακινήτων (Ειδική Εκτέλεση) (Τροποποιητικού) Νόμου του 2023, πιστοποιητικό έρευνας της ακίνητης ιδιοκτησίας η οποία αποτελεί αντικείμενο της σύμβασης, το οποίο φέρει ημερομηνία που δεν διαφέρει από την ημερομηνία υπογραφής της σύμβασης πέραν των πέντε (5) εργάσιμων ημερών. (1Β) Ανεξάρτητα από το εάν συντρέχει περίπτωση ποινικής ευθύνης δυνάμει των διατάξεων του παρόντος Νόμου, σε περίπτωση κατά την οποία πωλητής παραλείπει να συμμορφωθεί με την προβλεπόμενη στις διατάξεις του εδαφίου (1Α) υποχρέωση, ο Διευθυντής δύναται να επιβάλει σε αυτόν διοικητικό πρόστιμο το οποίο δεν υπερβαίνει τις δέκα χιλιάδες ευρώ (€10.000) [...]
rules.translation: (1A) Notwithstanding the provisions of the Contract Law, the seller includes as an integral part of the contract, concluded after the date on which the Sale of Immovable Property (Specific Performance) (Amending) Law of 2023 comes into force, a search certificate of the immovable property that is the subject of the contract, bearing a date that does not differ from the date the contract is signed by more than five (5) working days. (1B) Regardless of any criminal liability under this Law, where a seller fails to comply with the obligation in subsection (1A), the Director may impose on the seller an administrative fine not exceeding ten thousand euro (EUR 10,000) [...]

rules.title: If the property is already mortgaged, your contract is deposited only with a written declaration
rules.plain: When the only charges on the property are an existing mortgage or an earlier deposited contract, the Land Registry accepts your sale contract for deposit only together with a written declaration: either one by each mortgage lender and the seller (Form A), which you have signed to show you know it, or one by you as the buyer (Form C). Form A is what later lets you pay off the lender and take the property free of the mortgage.
rules.quote: 3A. Τηρουμένων των διατάξεων των παραγράφων (α), (β) και (γ) του εδαφίου (1) του άρθρου 3, σε περίπτωση κατά την οποία τα μοναδικά εμπράγματα βάρη στα οποία υπόκειται η ακίνητη ιδιοκτησία η οποία αποτελεί αντικείμενο της σύμβασης, είναι ήδη κατατεθειμένη υποθήκη ή κατατεθειμένη σύμβαση και ο εγγεγραμμένος ιδιοκτήτης αυτής δεν τελεί υπό απαγόρευση, η κατάθεση της σύμβασης από οποιοδήποτε από τα συμβαλλόμενα μέρη γίνεται αποδεκτή μόνο εάν συνοδεύεται από έγγραφη δήλωση: (α) εκάστου ενυπόθηκου δανειστή και πωλητή για την οποία ο αγοραστής ενυπογράφως έλαβε γνώση, κατά τον Τύπο Α του Παραρτήματος· ή (β) του αγοραστή κατά τον Τύπο Γ του Παραρτήματος.
rules.translation: 3A. Subject to paragraphs (a), (b) and (c) of subsection (1) of section 3, where the only real charges on the immovable property that is the subject of the contract are an already deposited mortgage or an already deposited contract, and its registered owner is not under a prohibition, the deposit of the contract by any of the contracting parties is accepted only if it is accompanied by a written declaration: (a) of each mortgage lender and the seller, of which the buyer has taken notice by signing, in Form A of the Annex; or (b) of the buyer, in Form C of the Annex.

rules.title: With a mortgage on the property, you pay into the seller account named in Form A and the lender must release it
rules.plain: If a mortgage was already registered when your contract was deposited with Form A, you pay the amount set in Form A into the seller bank account named in the declaration, and the lender must accept it. Every amount paid into that account, including a deposit paid at signing, counts as payment of the price. The lender must then give you a payment confirmation (Form B) and release the property from the mortgage. A lender that wilfully fails to do so can be fined up to EUR 100,000.
rules.quote: (2Α)(α) Ανεξάρτητα από τις διατάξεις του περί Μεταβιβάσεως και Υποθηκεύσεως Ακινήτων Νόμου, σε περίπτωση κατά την οποία πριν από την κατάθεση σύμβασης, η οποία συνοδεύεται από τον Τύπο Α του Παραρτήματος, σύμφωνα με τις διατάξεις του άρθρου 3Α, υπάρχει ήδη κατατεθειμένη υποθήκη η οποία επιβαρύνει την ακίνητη ιδιοκτησία η οποία αποτελεί το αντικείμενο της σύμβασης, ο αγοραστής και/ή ο πωλητής, σε περίπτωση κατά την οποία ο τελευταίος έλαβε προκαταβολή από τον αγοραστή κατά την υπογραφή της σύμβασης, καταθέτει σε τραπεζικό λογαριασμό του πωλητή, ο οποίος καθορίζεται στην έγγραφη δήλωση, το ποσό το οποίο καθορίζεται στον Τύπο Α του Παραρτήματος και ο ενυπόθηκος δανειστής υποχρεούται να το αποδεχθεί. [...] (γ) Ο ενυπόθηκος δανειστής με την αποδοχή του ποσού το οποίο καθορίζεται στον Τύπο Α του Παραρτήματος δίδει στον αγοραστή γραπτή βεβαίωση πληρωμής κατά τον Τύπο Β του Παραρτήματος και απαλλάσσει ή εξαλείφει την ακίνητη ιδιοκτησία η οποία αποτελεί αντικείμενο της σύμβασης από την εν λόγω υποθήκη [...]
rules.translation: (2A)(a) Notwithstanding the provisions of the Immovable Property (Transfer and Mortgage) Law, where, before the deposit of a contract accompanied by Form A of the Annex under section 3A, there is already a deposited mortgage on the immovable property that is the subject of the contract, the buyer and/or the seller, where the latter received a deposit from the buyer when the contract was signed, pays into the seller bank account named in the written declaration the amount set in Form A of the Annex, and the mortgage lender is obliged to accept it. [...] (c) On accepting the amount set in Form A of the Annex, the mortgage lender gives the buyer a written payment confirmation in Form B of the Annex and releases or discharges the immovable property that is the subject of the contract from that mortgage [...]

rules.title: Once the lender confirms payment, the property is transferred to you free of later charges
rules.plain: For a contract deposited with Form A after the amendment took effect, once the payment confirmation (Form B) has been issued, any district Land Registry office accepts the transfer, and the property passes to you regardless of charges or prohibitions on the property or its owner that rank after your contract. If the lender does not act, the Director of the Department of Lands and Surveys transfers the property into your name when you bring Form B signed and stamped by the lender.
rules.quote: (8) Ανεξάρτητα από τις διατάξεις του περί Μεταβιβάσεως και Υποθηκεύσεως Ακινήτων Νόμου, σε περίπτωση μεταβίβασης ακίνητης ιδιοκτησίας η οποία αποτελεί το αντικείμενο σύμβασης η οποία κατατέθηκε στο αρμόδιο Επαρχιακό Κτηματολογικό Γραφείο μετά από την ημερομηνία έναρξης της ισχύος του περί Πώλησης Ακινήτων (Ειδική Εκτέλεση) (Τροποποιητικού) Νόμου του 2023 και συνοδεύεται από τον Τύπο Α του Παραρτήματος, και νοουμένου ότι έχει εκδοθεί ο Τύπος Β του Παραρτήματος, η δήλωση μεταβίβασης γίνεται αποδεκτή σε οποιοδήποτε αρμόδιο Επαρχιακό Κτηματολογικό Γραφείο και η ακίνητη ιδιοκτησία μεταβιβάζεται ανεξάρτητα από οποιαδήποτε εμπράγματα βάρη ή απαγορεύσεις τα οποία τυχόν βαρύνουν την ακίνητη ιδιοκτησία ή τον ιδιοκτήτη της και τα οποία ακολουθούν κατά προτεραιότητα τη σύμβαση [...] (9) Σε περίπτωση κατά την οποία ο ενυπόθηκος δανειστής παραλείψει να ενεργήσει σύμφωνα με τις διατάξεις του παρόντος άρθρου, και νοουμένου ότι ο αγοραστής έχει προσκομίσει τη βεβαίωση πληρωμής, κατά τον Τύπο Β του Παραρτήματος, δεόντως υπογραμμένη και σφραγισμένη από τον ενυπόθηκο δανειστή, ο Διευθυντής μεταβιβάζει επ’ ονόματι του αγοραστή την ακίνητη ιδιοκτησία, ανεξάρτητα από οποιαδήποτε εμπράγματα βάρη ή απαγορεύσεις τα οποία τυχόν βαρύνουν την ακίνητη ιδιοκτησία ή τον ιδιοκτήτη της και τα οποία ακολουθούν κατά προτεραιότητα τη σύμβαση.
rules.translation: (8) Notwithstanding the provisions of the Immovable Property (Transfer and Mortgage) Law, in a transfer of immovable property that is the subject of a contract deposited at the competent District Land Registry after the Sale of Immovable Property (Specific Performance) (Amending) Law of 2023 comes into force and accompanied by Form A of the Annex, and provided that Form B of the Annex has been issued, the declaration of transfer is accepted at any competent District Land Registry and the property is transferred regardless of any real charges or prohibitions that may burden the property or its owner and that rank after the contract [...] (9) Where the mortgage lender fails to act under this section, and provided that the buyer has produced the payment confirmation in Form B of the Annex, duly signed and stamped by the mortgage lender, the Director transfers the property into the name of the buyer, regardless of any real charges or prohibitions that may burden the property or its owner and that rank after the contract.

rules.title: In India, a project must be registered with the state RERA before any unit is advertised or sold
rules.plain: A developer may not advertise, book or sell any apartment or plot in a project in a planning area until the project is registered with the Real Estate Regulatory Authority of the state. Ask for the RERA registration number and look it up on the state authority website before you pay.
rules.quote: No promoter shall advertise, market, book, sell or offer for sale, or invite persons to purchase in any manner any plot, apartment or building, as the case may be, in any real estate project or part of it, in any planning area, without registering the real estate project with the Real Estate Regulatory Authority established under this Act

rules.title: 70% of what buyers pay must go into a separate bank account for that project
rules.plain: The developer must put 70% of the money received from buyers into a separate account at a scheduled bank, to be used only for the construction and land cost of that project. Money can leave the account only in proportion to construction progress, certified by an engineer, an architect and a chartered accountant, and the accounts are audited every year.
rules.quote: (D) that seventy per cent. of the amounts realised for the real estate project from the allottees, from time to time, shall be deposited in a separate account to be maintained in a scheduled bank to cover the cost of construction and the land cost and shall be used only for that purpose: Provided that the promoter shall withdraw the amounts from the separate account, to cover the cost of the project, in proportion to the percentage of completion of the project: Provided further that the amounts from the separate account shall be withdrawn by the promoter after it is certified by an engineer, an architect and a chartered accountant in practice that the withdrawal is in proportion to the percentage of completion of the project

rules.title: No more than 10% of the price before a registered written agreement for sale
rules.plain: A developer may not take more than 10% of the price as an advance or application fee until it has signed a written agreement for sale with you and registered it. If you are asked for more before that, stop.
rules.quote: A promoter shall not accept a sum more than ten per cent of the cost of the apartment, plot, or building as the case may be, as an advance payment or an application fee, from a person without first entering into a written agreement for sale with such person and register the said agreement for sale, under any law for the time being in force.

rules.title: If the home is not handed over on time, you can take your money back with interest, or stay and be paid interest each month
rules.plain: If the developer does not complete or hand over the home by the date in the agreement for sale, or stops business, you can withdraw and claim back everything you paid with interest at the rate set by the state rules, plus compensation. If you stay in the project, the developer must pay you interest for every month of delay until handover.
rules.quote: [...] he shall be liable on demand to the allottees, in case the allottee wishes to withdraw from the project, without prejudice to any other remedy available, to return the amount received by him in respect of that apartment, plot, building, as the case may be, with interest at such rate as may be prescribed in this behalf including compensation in the manner as provided under this Act: Provided that where an allottee does not intend to withdraw from the project, he shall be paid, by the promoter, interest for every month of delay, till the handing over of the possession, at such rate as may be prescribed.
